sections.description: Mood-based lead story plus a concise summary of the dominant kinds of activity during the game.
Compact final standings box with the winner and each player's LP score.
User-friendly counts of the action categories that most often appeared in the recorded trigger history.
Short player-by-player summaries based only on the actions, story outcomes, and one-off encounters actually recorded for that player.
A prose roundup of the territory-wide events that occurred during the game.
A prose roundup of unusual one-off incidents, grouped around the riders who encountered them.
One short article for every Character Arc that began, including completed, missed, and still-unfinished chapters.
A concise roundup of any territory-wide major storylines that progressed during the game.
A dynamic closing paragraph shaped by the frontier mood, dominant activity, stories, world events, one-offs, and final winner.
